vehicledamage.title: Vehicle Damage Detection System
vehicledamage.description: Developed a Vehicle Damage Detection system consisting of a combination of YOLO models with a FastAPI wrapper hosted in Huggingface spaces. Pre-trained the models on Image datasets, versioned and deployed using MLOps tools. Also further developed the live mobile app to support new features which is in Playstore and Appstore.
deliverables: Developed a vehicle damage detection system with DL models, API and Mobile app.
Pre-trained the models on specialized image datasets, versioned and deployed using MLOps tools like Weights & Biases and Roboflow.
Further developed the live mobile app to support new inspection features, published in the Play Store and App Store.

airento.title: AiRentoSoft System
airento.description: Collaborated in Developing and Implementing new features including AI Integrations. Worked on the React Web application, Reservations Plugin, .NET API, and developed the 2.0 version of the Mobile app with similar features to the main system and released documentation in AZURE Devops. Added AI Integrated features like document scanning, card scanning using OCR models in both web and mobile apps. Also managed and worked on the AI Caller agent in Retel.ai for client requirements.
deliverables: Collaborated in developing and implementing new features including AI integrations across web and mobile systems.
Worked on the React web application, Reservations Plugin, .NET API, and developed the 2.0 version of the mobile application.
Released documentation in Azure DevOps and collaborated with developers, business support, and QA teams via Jira sprints.
Added AI-integrated features like document scanning and card scanning using custom OCR models in web and mobile apps.
Managed and configured the AI Caller agent on Retel.ai to automate client inquiry workflows.

businessleads.title: Business Leads Extraction Pipeline
businessleads.description: Implemented a business leads extraction pipeline for extracting potential clients in USA based car rental businesses using Automation scripts and web scraping and using ETL pipelines to process data into understandable formats for business support division to use.
deliverables: Assisted in extracting business leads for potential USA-based car rental clients using automation scripts to improve business opportunities.
Developed web scraping workflows utilizing Playwright and Selenium to reliably collect lead data.
Processed scraped data through custom ETL pipelines to deliver structured formats for sales and support teams.
Collaborated with developers, business support, and QA teams via Jira within scheduled sprints.

sinhalatts.title: Sinhala TTS Model
sinhalatts.description: Developed a research purpose private TTS model with support for Sinhala language. Created a private dataset from scratch for VITS format to train the Speech Model. Trained on Kaggle dual T4 GPUs and gained research level quality output for product pitching and further development with funds.
deliverables: Developed a research-purpose private TTS model supporting the Sinhala language.
Created a private dataset from scratch formatted for VITS format to train the speech model.
Trained on Kaggle dual T4 GPUs, achieving research-level quality output for product pitching.
Utilized outputs for product pitching, gaining support for further funded development.

togo.title: TOGO - AI Shopping Assistant
togo.description: Developed an Agentic Shopping assistant for e-commerce website for baby care products. Implemented features in Product search, QnA using store policies and customer support. This is live on the TOGO website.
deliverables: Developed an Agentic Shopping Assistant for a baby care products e-commerce website (TOGO).
Implemented multi-agent orchestration for product search and interactive QnA using store policies.
Integrated Langfuse for observability, tracking agent traces, and optimizing LLM latency.
Engineered real-time customer support capabilities, deployed live on the TOGO website.

fashionhub.title: FashionHub.ai - AI Shopping Assistant
fashionhub.description: Developed an intelligent AI shopping assistant that revolutionises the retail experience by utilising a ReAct capable Agent with DAG-based task execution. The platform features a high-throughput MongoDB to Weaviate Kafka pipeline for real-time data synchronization. Built on a scalable FastAPI microservices infrastructure, the system integrates a modular multi-LLM factory (Gemini, Llama) and Google Vertex AI for generative Virtual Try-On capabilities, delivering a seamless and context-aware customer assistance. Used LangChain & LangGraph for LLM orchestration and agent state management.
deliverables: Engineered an AI-powered shopping assistant (FashionHub.ai) for customers to get assistance on product search, Virtual Try-On, Cart management, Payment assistance, QnA and Size matching.
Leader of the AI/ML Intern team of five, providing technical guidance on project architecture, code reviews, and implementation strategies and regular meetings to ensure milestones were met.

Conducted research and integration by collaborating and leading the team members with LLM orchestration techniques, reasoning and multi-model pipelines that enabled complex product recommendations and Virtual Try-On features.
Built a high-throughput MongoDB-to-Weaviate Kafka pipeline for real-time data synchronization.
Implemented a modular multi-LLM factory supporting Gemini, local Llama via Ollama, and Google Vertex AI for Virtual Try-On.

reportingdashboard.title: Weekly Report Generator & Team Dashboard
reportingdashboard.description: Engineered an asynchronous Weekly Report Generator and Team Dashboard built with FastAPI, MongoDB, React 19 (TypeScript), Zustand 5, and Tailwind CSS. Features role-based access control (RBAC) across Contributors, Managers, and Admins, real ISO calendar standardization, immutable report versioning, and live KPI analytics. Integrated an intelligent AI layer using LangGraph and LangChain with Groq LLM for real-time team deliverable insights, automated blocker analysis, and conversational rolling summarization.
deliverables: Architected a scalable 3-tier system using FastAPI (async Motor MongoDB driver) and React 19 + TypeScript with Zustand 5 for zero-redundancy client caching.
Implemented robust Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) governing Contributor submissions, Manager review queues with feedback loops, and Admin configurations.
Built an intelligent AI Assistant utilizing LangGraph StateGraph, LangChain RAG, and Groq LLM with a 5-response rolling summarizer and ephemeral session memory.
Engineered live KPI analytics and interactive data visualizations using Recharts, tracking submission compliance, workload distributions, and open blockers.
Designed MongoDB hybrid document pattern combining normalized metadata with embedded version snapshots and review history.
Containerized the complete full-stack environment using Docker Compose for streamlined multi-service deployment.

univize.title: Univize - University Social App
univize.description: Developed an Social application for university students with features including, medial sharing, direct messaging and forum based discussions. Led the development team in system design to development, testing and deployment. Used Azure as the hosting platform with services like container registry, secret management and containerized apps. Developed the main backend in Django and FastAPI with PostgreSQL (Supabase), MongoDB, Neo4J, Redis and Supabase. Built the CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and Azure Bicep scripts for infrastructure provisioning and Integration. This was done as the Group project for USJP.
deliverables: Developed a social application for university students with features including media sharing, direct messaging, and forum-based discussions.
Led the development team in system design to development, testing, and deployment.
Used Azure as the hosting platform with services like container registry, secret management, and containerized apps.
Developed the main backend in Django and FastAPI with PostgreSQL (Supabase), MongoDB, Neo4J, Redis, and Supabase.
Built the CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions and Azure Bicep scripts for infrastructure provisioning and integration.
